What it covers

Mini-grids provide whole-community power, integrating solar generation, energy storage, distribution and smart metering. They replace expensive, polluting diesel generators with clean, reliable 24/7 power.

Solar + Storage + Smart Metering

A clean, reliable power supply that enables productive use of energy, business growth, improved healthcare and education, and a higher quality of life for community members.
